purpose: Improve neural card recognition on browser-style glyphs without training on draft captures

training.selection: First epoch with highest exact validation count
training.augmentation: Training-only stochastic grayscale, downsample/upsample, intensity and zero-padded translation

limitations: Old-domain regression prevents replacing the incumbent
Captured examples are correlated, draft-geometry development data from one session
Captured collection influenced experiment design; not an untouched generalization test
Detector still emits 26 false proposals and misses four captured card appearances
No player roles, whole-table state, confidence calibration or coaching readiness is established
These are perception weights, not a completed GTO strategy model
next_work: Add old-domain rehearsal during training, then evaluate on newly sealed captures and synthetic sessions before any promotion
